name: Do me a Favour
source:
"Do Me a Favor."
Here you take on the role of a young blacksmith who is forced by mysterious circumstances to travel to the kingdom of "Krom" and open a forge there. On your journey you will encounter many interesting creatures and characters, tricky tasks, and of course a lot of "love".

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/guidancegames]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
“帮我一个忙。”
在这里，你扮演一名年轻的铁匠，在神秘的情况下被迫前往“克罗姆”王国并在那里开设铁匠铺。在你的旅程中，你会遇到许多有趣的生物和角色，棘手的任务，当然还有很多“爱”。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/guidancegames]Patreon[/url]]
